spans.s: adyatve, loc. = adya, today, in the present time (so Skt. Gr., BR 〔5.968〕): LV 〔155.20〕 (prose); adyatvena, instr., id.: MSV 〔i.89.20〕; 〔ii.186.15〕.

adyāgre, Karmav 〔158.4〕 (much more commonly adyāgreṇa, see s.v. -agreṇa), and adyād-agre Karmav 〔158.3〕, from now on: = Pali ajjatagge, ajjadagge (but not ˚aggena!), derived by CPD from *ajjato agge, a theory perhaps supported by adyād (abl.?) agre (but *adya-dagre, with hiatus-bridging d, see 〔§ 4.64〕, might have been secondarily reinterpreted as adyād-).
